title: Bukidnon town belies viral P50 'burial aid' claim

blocks.text: SAN FERNANDO, Bukidnon — The municipal government of San Fernando, Bukidnon, has vehemently refuted viral social media claims that it gave a mere P50 in burial assistance to a grieving mother, clarifying that its official program provides direct funeral services worth up to P20,000 rather than cash handouts. In a statement on Sunday, Mayor Rogelio Yeke expressed the local government unit’s (LGU) condolences to the bereaved family while presenting official records to counter the backlash sparked by a November 11 Facebook post.
